note: index 0 = bare-MOF reference; train/val only for a later FT comparison, ICL shows all
subset_rule:
Add nested N=10 and N=5 subsets to every inputs_pairs/examples/<MOF>/split.json (N=20 entry unchanged).
Order: trajectories in default_rng(0) order, frames within each trajectory in default_rng(0) order, then round-robin over
trajectories; N subset = first N of that order (so 5 in 10 in 20, one frame per trajectory first). Index 0 (bare ref) always
in train. FT val count: N=10 -> 2, N=5 -> 1, chosen as subset[default_rng(0).permutation(N)[-nv:]] (as in the catalyst runs).
